name: Herzla
summary: Bavarian reverse trick-taking game where 4 players avoid capturing Hearts.
rules_text: Use 32-card German-suited pack ranking Ace, King, Ober, Unter, Ten, 9, 8, 7. Deal 8 cards to each player clockwise. Before play players may bid Beddl to take no tricks or Mord to take all tricks, priority by position; highest bidder is declarer vs three defenders. Otherwise play normal avoidance game. Forehand leads, no trumps, hearts may not be led to first two tricks. Must follow suit if possible, no requirement to win trick. In Beddl declarer loses immediately upon taking a trick. In Mord declarer loses immediately upon losing a trick. Schleichermord is an unannounced Mord. Score with cents to pot: in normal game each heart taken costs, paid to players who took none; other settlements as described; first to fewest penalties wins variant.
